name: Preview Segment
description: Registers a media segment provider with Jellyfin. For every supported episode that already has an Intro segment, the provider returns a Preview segment from the start of the episode (0s) to the beginning of the intro, so clients can offer a "preview" skip. Applicability is controlled entirely by Jellyfin's own per-library Media Segment Providers settings.
overview: Adds a Preview media segment to episodes that already have an Intro segment.
